root: the Vernant checkout; run bin/fm-guard-lint.sh --root <vernant> with these paths
note: Seeded with the guards this audit pass repaired or proved in Vernant. The remaining audited Vernant guards are unregistered debt: data/guard-audit-closure-2026-10-22.md lists them with their tier and the reason no registry entry exists yet. The audit's prose names set-required.py but its ranking table has no row for it, so it is listed in beyond_audit_retired and counted separately.

guards.invariant: a Stop is prevented when any validator reports a blocking severity
guards.trigger: any collected violation has severity CRITICAL, HIGH, or ERROR
guards.proxy_reason: validator verdicts are the only available judgment of the checks they implement; a deterministic re-implementation of every validator is out of scope
guards.remedy: fix the named violation, then rerun the session; scripts/hooks/stop_orchestrator.py --self-test <corpus-dir> replays the block decision

guards.invariant: a task never completes while a claimed deliverable file is missing
guards.source: the backticked or extension-bearing bullets under a deliverables: key in the task description
guards.trigger: a claimed deliverable path does not exist under the project directory
guards.remedy: create the missing deliverable at <path>, or drop the bullet; .claude/commands/hooks/validators/task-completion-gate.py names every missing path it checked

guards.invariant: a dangerous command pattern is denied before any safe-prefix allow
guards.source: BLOCKED_PATTERNS from bash-validator.py and the anchored SAFE_PATTERNS list
guards.trigger: a PermissionRequest command matches a blocked pattern, alone or after a safe prefix
guards.remedy: run the denied segment alone after reviewing it: <segment>; .claude/commands/hooks/validators/auto-approve-safe-commands.py reports the matched pattern

guards.invariant: a credential env file is never read or edited through a tool call
guards.source: the final path component of tool_input.file_path
guards.trigger: the final component is .env, .envrc, or .env.<anything> other than a template
guards.remedy: read the value through the approved config loader, or copy the key name into .env.sample; .claude/commands/hooks/validators/env-file-guardian.py owns the decision

guards.invariant: a destructive shell action is refused and a read-only one is allowed
guards.source: shlex tokens and realpath per control-operator segment
guards.trigger: a segment recursively deletes outside tmp, pipes curl to shell, or force-pushes main
guards.remedy: run the refused segment alone after reviewing it: <segment>; .claude/commands/hooks/validators/bash-validator.py names the matched rule

guards.invariant: every registered hook path resolves to a file that exists
guards.trigger: a registered $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR or repo-root path does not exist
guards.remedy: register an existing script path, or remove the entry: <path> (the manifest at .claude/hooks/.hooks-manifest.json must match)

guards.invariant: an ad-hoc grep over Drive paths never stands in for the authoritative A3 inventory
guards.source: shlex argv head plus the Drive path tokens
guards.trigger: argv head is grep, carries -r, and names a Cloud or My Drive path

guards.invariant: a first-party import is never wrapped in try/except ImportError
guards.source: the file content, the prohibited pattern, and the reviewed data allowlist
guards.trigger: a try/except ImportError wraps a src. import whose module is not allowlisted with a reason
guards.remedy: declare it with a reason in scripts/hooks/optional-import-allowlist.json as {"allow":[{"import":"<module>","reason":"<why>"}]}, or use a direct import
